name: flow-medic
subtitle: Diagnose a failed automation run from its error and logs
title: Flow Medic
installMethods: Upload the folder as a zip in Claude apps: Customize > Skills (upload not tried by us)

permissions.files: Reads its own reference files and any log or export file the user points at. Writes nothing.
permissions.shell: None. It does not run, re-run or fetch anything named in the logs. Bundles no scripts.
